written.headline: IBM Research builds Indic voice agent using CUGA harness
written.summary: IBM Research built a regional language voice agent using the CUGA open-source agent harness to answer farming questions from a 154-page English agricultural handbook. The system listens in regional languages, searches the document, and replies in two to four spoken sentences.
